overview: Elitz is the original development, separate from Elitz 2 and Elitz 3. Danube lists 592 apartments and describes residential, retail and commercial uses.

The developer’s inspection dated 30 September 2026 reports 94% progress with commissioning and snagging in progress. This dated internal update does not establish completed handover or regulatory certification.
research.locationNote: Jumeirah Village Circle, Dubai. Marketing maps and access routes do not establish guaranteed driving or walking times.
research.priceNote: Property Finder lists AED 650,000 at launch; its separate studio table starts around AED 703,000. The developer hero says SOLD OUT. These references do not establish a current selected-unit quote or resale availability.
research.paymentNote: Danube’s hero displays 30/70 without milestone dates, while its lower copy retains 1% monthly. Property Finder’s historical schedule is 10% booking, 42% construction, 8% on handover and 40% afterward. Confirm the selected unit’s signed terms; these summaries are not combined into a current offer.
research.handoverNote: The developer hero says October 2026 but its FAQ retains December 2025; Property Finder labels the project Ready with a December 2025 date. Danube’s 30 September 2026 inspection reports 94% construction, commissioning and snagging. Actual completed handover and the selected contract’s date remain unverified.

facts.label: Dated developer progress
facts.value: Danube’s internal inspection on 30 September 2026 reports 94% overall progress with commissioning and snagging underway. This does not establish completed handover.

unresolved: Own print plan p19 states 3,459–3,709 ft² for the penthouse; the broker mirror prints 3,469–3,709 with star/hash variants. Neither printed range fully reconciles with rounded components. Confirm the exact unit’s certified plan; the two illustrated levels are not doubled.
Current resale/developer availability, signed completion, current milestone dates, booking fees, furniture, parking, service/cooling charges and title terms remain unverified.
Some layouts include a pool, office or maid’s room; these are not universal features. Shared amenities are marketed concepts rather than independently verified operating services.
